verdict.rationale: The CI docs tell users to commit a lockfile, link to a dedicated lockfile doc page, and support `mise install --locked` for reproducible installs. The security docs show `mise lock --bump --dry-run --json`, which gives an agent machine-readable output for proposed lock changes. The evidence never describes the lockfile's on-disk format, so it is not shown to be text-based or easy to diff. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the lockfile's text format and contents (e.g. structure, checksums, per-platform entries), evidence that it diffs cleanly in version control, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents reading or diffing it.
